# pricing-service

> Monetary definitions + saga-aware price locking.

- [Overview](wiki/overview.md): Domain model, currency handling, lock/unlock semantics, outbox, endpoints, tests.

- Domain: `services/pricing-service/src/domain/models.py`

- Tests: `services/pricing-service/tests/`
